# 2 Baruch Chapter 15 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** First Fast and Vision

---

**1** The Lord answered me: "You asked about all the good things that have disappeared from the world and what kind of salvation is coming.

**2** Regarding what you said — yes, this world will receive what is coming to it, in its own time. But the promise of the life to come will not fail.

**3** To the Most High, this world is simply trouble and exhaustion. But the world to come is a crown — full of glory for those who did not stumble along the way.

**4** I do not count the endurance of this world as meaningful unless it has produced righteousness. Those who did not love my Law and did not grasp the ways of the Most High will get nothing from it.

**5** But those who loved me, who stayed faithful to my ways, who did not invest their lives in this present world but invested their souls in the world to come — they will receive everything they were promised.

**6** If they are suffering now, they will be glorified then. Great sorrow will produce great glory.

**7** As for the righteous, they will testify in the end that they endured real tribulation.

**8** And everything will become clear at the end. Not one of them will be cast away from the presence of the Most High. Their time will come."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering. V.3 "simply trouble and exhaustion" adds "simply" for rhetorical contrast with the coming age. V.6 "great sorrow will produce great glory" rendered directly as the thesis. V.8 "everything will become clear" makes the eschatological revealing explicit.*
